_description: Template-based questions for required fields (no LLM needed)
_usage: When missing a simple field with no ambiguity, use these templates instead of LLM

questions: Where would you like to go?
What destination is calling your name?
Where are you dreaming of traveling?
Any place in particular you have in mind?
Which corner of the world interests you?
Where should we plan your adventure?

hotels: Where are you dreaming of staying?
Which destination are you looking for accommodation?
Where should I search for hotels?
flights: Where would you like to fly to?
activities: Where would you like to explore activities?
Which destination for things to do?
Where should I look for activities?
transport: Where will you need to get around?

destinations_clarify._description: V16: Used when destination extraction fails or is ambiguous

ambiguous_place: I found a few places that might match "{user_input}". Which one did you mean?
There are multiple destinations called "{user_input}". Could you be more specific?
unknown_place: I'm not sure I recognize "{user_input}" as a destination. Could you tell me more about where you'd like to go?
I couldn't find a destination matching "{user_input}". Did you mean something else?
typo_detected: I think there might be a typo in "{user_input}". Did you mean "{suggestion}"?
low_confidence: Just to make sure I got it right - you want to go to "{extracted_value}"?
I want to make sure I understood - your destination is "{extracted_value}"?
multiple_destinations: I found multiple destinations: {destinations_list}. Would you like to visit all of them on the same trip?
Are you planning to visit {destinations_list} together, or just one of them?

questions: Where will you be traveling from?
